title: The Ghost Config Key (Schemaless Config Reading)
pattern: Reading configuration properties at arbitrary code locations using raw string queries against schemaless containers without schema declarations.
why_bad: Allows typos to compile without warnings, leading to runtime failures that are hard to diagnose since values fallback silently to empty states or wrong defaults.
detection: In-line string-literal lookups targeting dynamic configuration brokers across multiple functional files.
fix: Compile configurations directly into structured Rust types on application startup, eliminating dynamic key lookups from business logic.
source: Marianne Bellotti - *Kill It with Fire* (2021, No Starch Press).pdf, Chapter 3.
